figures.name: overview
figures.title: Overview (`result.plot()`)
figures.shows: The figure that `result.plot()` saves: (a) clonal programmes on the clone map, (b) clonal coherence, (c) programme stability, (d) programme sizes.

figures.name: coherence
figures.title: Clonal coherence
figures.shows: Share of transcriptional variance explained by clone identity (clonal ICC), observed and with clone labels shuffled within each `donor x sample` (bar: mean of 200 permutations; whisker: their central 95 %).

figures.name: clone_map_clone_size
figures.title: Clone map: clone size
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the number of cells of each clone.

figures.name: clone_map_reliability
figures.title: Clone map: profile reliability
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by the reliability of each clone's profile (0 to 1; it grows with the number of cells sampled from the clone).

figures.name: clone_map_donor
figures.title: Clone map: donor
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by donor, one panel per donor, every other clone in grey.

figures.name: clone_map_antigen_call
figures.title: Clone map: antigen_call
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `antigen_call`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: clone_map_isotype
figures.title: Clone map: isotype
figures.shows: The clone map coloured by `isotype`, the level held by at least half of each clone's cells, one panel per level, every other clone in grey (clones without such a majority appear only in grey).

figures.name: label_effects
figures.title: Label effects
figures.shows: For each tested label, the share of the variance between clone profiles that it explains (blue) and the same with the label shuffled among clones of the same donor and of similar size (grey), with the permutation P value.

figures.name: memory_visit
figures.title: Clonal memory over visit
figures.shows: How much a clone's profile changes between levels of `visit`, against other clones of the same donor seen at the same two levels; the title gives the memory index with its 95 % CI.

figures.name: heritability
figures.title: Gene heritability
figures.shows: Clonal ICC of every gene expressed in at least 5 % of the cells of clones with two or more cells (receptor genes excluded), by rank; the 12 highest are named (`tl.gene_heritability` with its defaults).

figures.name: cells_antigen_call
figures.title: Cells: antigen_call
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `antigen_call`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.

figures.name: cells_isotype
figures.title: Cells: isotype
figures.shows: Cells on a UMAP of the embedding the run used (`X_threadfin`): the cells of each level of `isotype`, one panel per level, on the grey of all cells.
